author: Ryan Daws
description:
Endava is overhauling the traditional fullstack by deploying specialised AI agents to automate the entire software delivery process. At the centre of this push is a unified platform integrating ChatGPT Enterprise alongside OpenAI’s Codex models. Endava isn’t just handing these tools to its developers as standalone assistants, they are building a network of separate agents […]

title: Endava builds AI agent network to automate software delivery
